panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Vertex clinical photo of infant head showing mild right-sided occipital flattening of deformational plagiocephaly with parallelogram asymmetry; red/green axes are overlays only. B: Vertex clinical photo of infant head showing severe right-sided occipital flattening with contralateral frontal deformity of deformational plagiocephaly with parallelogram asymmetry.

panels.figure_caption: Deformational plagiocephaly.
